name: frontend-devkit
description: Private development platform: a framework-agnostic core plus per-framework engineering packs. Repo-specific facts live in each consuming repo's .claude/project.json, never in a component.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic: a read-only reviewer agent, bug investigation, feature planning, commit/MR authoring, prompt rewriting, and three deterministic hooks. Install in every repository.

plugins.name: vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 / Vite SPA engineering and review knowledge: reactivity, composables, Vue Router, client vs server state, build-time config and secrets, testing. Version-gated against the installed Vue, Router, Pinia, Vite and TypeScript. Contains no repo-specific facts. Requires core.
